Results.ReviewText:
I grew up with Weber, specifically their charcoal line.  After purchasing a home, I knew I wanted to make this investment and commit to something that I knew would last a long time.  I did plenty of research before landing on the Spirit II E-310.  As a novice cook, one of the reasons I wanted this specific grill was because of its compatibility with the iGrill3 thermometer.  It is advertised EVERYWHERE that it works with the badge on the Spirit II line.  After assembling the grill, I was hit with an addendum stating the right table NO LONGER came with the badge.  How in the world is it appropriate to still advertise it as compatible but not include it in the actual grill?  I have tried every method of contacting Weber for clarification.  Via email, I received one response and it was automatically generated and included the instructions for installing the thermometer (assuming the badge was still on the grill!!!).  Via phone, customer service had zero idea the grill was shipping without the badge so they had no suggestions other than to use the thermometer and just place it on the table.  

Cherry on top, I have owned this grill for a little over a week and now the warming grate is constantly falling off.  You can tell it was produced with very little room for error and the slightest movement of the grill or high temp will cause it to fall off.  

As someone who grew up with this brand and trusted it with my first home grill, I will not be coming back.  I expected much more from Weber.
Results.Title: Horrendous Customer Service

Results.ReviewText:
Had to replace our old Weber of 14 years because the frame had rusted out and the wheels started breaking off.  We cook on the grill year round and the grill is not covered.  Use to cover it years ago but it would still get wet anyway.  Best thing about Weber they are still going to be around years later when you need replacement parts.  In the long run you will get your monies worth.

The new E-310 heats up much quicker.  Having the 3 burners position front to back is much better for cooking than the old way of the burners running left to right.  I hope the newer still grates hold up over time.  Only small issue is, why install porcelain cover steel grease guards.  At this price point the grill should come standard with the stainless steel covers which I will have to replace in the future.  Once you replace them you never have to again. 

Still love the Weber product.
Results.Title: Replace Old Weber With A New Improved Weber

Results.ReviewText: Technically, this seems to be an excellent device: sturdy construction and very consistent heat. My only complaint: it produces food that tastes like it was baked in an oven, not a grill. After 10+ years with a Weber Q 300/3000, as well as various charcoal grills, I want not just the grill marks, but a bit of smoky flavor in my grilled food. Slightly disappointing results for burgers, chicken, and pork tenderloin so far.
Results.Title: Great device, but disappointing results
